mechanism: Both drugs are hepatically metabolized and fenofibrate may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing albendazole metabolism and active metabolite levels; albendazole also has hepatotoxic potential that may be compounded by fenofibrate.
action: Monitor liver function tests (AST, ALT, bilirubin) at baseline and periodically during concurrent use; consider baseline and follow-up imaging for helminthic infections to assess albendazole efficacy.
